messages.content: Suppose a sequence of polynomials B_n(x) converge pointwise to f(x) on [0, 1]. Does it follow that the B_n converge uniformly? Ensure that stop words constitute no more than 20% of the total words in your response.

message.content: No. Pointwise convergence lacks uniformity guarantees. Counterexample: $B_n(x) = x^n$. For $x \in [0,1)$, limit zero. At $x=1$, limit one. Function discontinuous. Polynomials continuous. Uniform limit must continuous. Contradiction. Thus, no uniform convergence.
